mapper.select: SELECT UPLOAD_ID, FILE_NAME, ROW_COUNT, UPLOADED_AT FROM CARD_UPLOAD WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY UPLOADED_AT DESC, UPLOAD_ID DESC

SELECT c.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_NAME, e.PAY_METHOD, SUM(e.AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM EXPENSE e JOIN SPEND_CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_ID = e.CATEGORY_ID WHERE e.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND e.USED_DATE >= #{fromDate} AND e.USED_DATE < #{toDate} GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_NAME, e.PAY_METHOD ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_ID, e.PAY_METHOD
